title: Portrait and Cellar
author: Ines Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Sterling, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
